title: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent in Power Systems
summary: China Southern Power Grid reports that its flow-control agent outperformed dispatchers in control evaluations. Energy and emissions benefits are not quantified.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Southern Power Grid reports grid deployment and continuing development of a flow-control agent that outperformed dispatchers in control evaluations. The account provides no independent verification of this gain. Energy and emissions benefits remain unquantified.
purpose: Optimize power dispatch while maintaining transmission and stability constraints.
system: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent
developer: China Southern Power Grid Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd.

ratings.reason: The deployed agent reportedly outperformed human dispatchers in comprehensive control evaluations. The size of the improvement remains unquantified.
More renewable energy and lower emissions are intended benefits; their extent is not measured.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent in Power Systems

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Real-time grid-state data and operational safety constraints

headline: An AI agent supports power-grid dispatch
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
